Name: Explosive Ammo Replacer
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
This mod replaces the default explosive ammo sprite with something more fun for your blowing stuff up pleasure. 

Current options are:

• Baby
• Eevee
• Junimo (red, green, and purple options)
• Pam
• Random

** NEW ** 
New Sprite Options were added in version 1.3 thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/NassiLove/mods]NassiLove[/url]

• Cheeto
• Himeko ** From [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44286]Arumi the Acress NPC Mod[/url] ),
